messages.subject: Ashfield v Marwick - evidence list
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Can you start a chronology and a disclosure index for Ashfield? Key facts: PO-AD-4471, 14 Mar 2024, 60 x MD-450 at £3,150 = £189,000. Failures from 17 Sep 2024; 41 of 60 within warranty. Renshaw says undersized output bearing + bad case-hardening on the bevel pinion.

The pinch point will be Marwick's clause 11 limitation of liability. Flag anything in the file that helps us on UCTA reasonableness.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Ashfield v Marwick - evidence list
messages.plaintextBody:
On it. First cut of the chronology and the disclosure index by end of week. One useful point: Lesley Kane at Marwick emailed Paul on 11 March 2024 saying the MD-450 was "more than adequate for continuous conveyor duty of the kind you describe" - that's good for fitness-for-purpose and for showing they knew the application. I'll exhibit it.

Elena
